name: Social pension for senior citizens (Tamil Nadu)
benefit: Monthly pension for eligible elderly persons; income/destitution conditions apply

rules.text: Applicant must be 60 or older (further income/destitution conditions apply)

manual_checks: Income and destitution criteria; confirm current state rules with the Revenue Dept / VAO
application_steps: Ask your Village Administrative Officer (VAO) / taluk office about the current form and conditions.
Keep age proof, residence proof and bank details ready.
Note the application number in the Applications tab.
conflict_note: Often only one social pension per person is allowed - confirm with the Revenue Dept/VAO
